safeguards: No product creation, store submission, paid infrastructure or real purchase performed by this file.
Product IDs must match Web, native catalog policy and local StoreKit catalog; cannot silently rename one side.
Local StoreKit prices do not prove available Japanese App Store price points.
Do not enable Apple Family Sharing for purchases until purchaser ownership and entitlement-sharing design is reviewed; app household sharing is a separate feature.
Streamlined purchases outside the app need account binding and recovery validation; enabled store setting alone is not proof of compatibility.
